summary: Protect JetBrains Local History from automatic cleanup

delivery.outcome: Protect mixed JetBrains system directories, including irreplaceable LocalHistory, from automatic and explicit bulk cleanup.
nonGoals: Nie wykonuje żadnej komendy cleanup na systemie podczas testów.
Nie usuwa istniejących danych użytkownika ani nie zmienia konfiguracji Dockera.
Nie zmienia aktywnego zakresu naprawy pamięci analizatora dysku poza jego sugestiami cleanupu.

architecture.decision: Classify JetBrains as protected mixed data and offer read-only inventory only. No bulk deletion command; dedicated selective cache cleanup is deferred.

validation.evidence: Two targeted regressions failed before the fix. All 36 focused cleanup tests pass after the fix. Ruff changed-file lint and git diff --check pass.
Full suite: 690 passed, 5 skipped, 16 deselected (slow/docker/real_api), Python 3.13.12. Governance: zero errors and warnings. Protected publication pending.
